description: CHAP is the modelling platform maintained by the DHIS2 CHAP project for connecting health data to predictive models. Its backend manages modelling services and can run model overlays through Docker; the repository gives a development Compose setup and a Kubernetes chart. Users provide health observations, location and time settings, and a compatible forecasting model. The outputs are model forecasts or analyses for the configured disease and health-service area. Geographic coverage depends on the connected DHIS2 data and model, not a fixed dataset bundled with CHAP. The code is free under AGPL-3.0, with public documentation and a Python package. A limitation is that this platform does not establish the accuracy of a particular disease model or the quality of reported case data. It can help model future demand on health services when calibrated to a local reporting system. The related catalogue record for Malawi's DHIS2 health-facility registry is a separate data source, not a bundled CHAP model. No health records, container images or package were downloaded.
